description: This file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationService class, which provides methods to interact with reporting methods, including CRUD operations, searching, and normalization. It acts as a service layer connecting data access objects with application logic within the HRM system.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class providing various operations related to reporting methods in the HR management system, including CRUD, search, and normalization functionalities.

methods.name: getReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ReportingMethodConfigurationDao instance.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Saves a ReportingMethod entity to the database.

methods.name: getReportingMethodById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod entity by its ID.

methods.name: getReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod entity by its name.

methods.name: getReportingMethodList
methods.description: Returns a list of reporting methods based on search filters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Returns the count of reporting methods matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Deletes multiple reporting methods by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if a reporting method name already exists.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of reporting methods currently in use.

methods.name: getReportingMethodArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized reporting methods matching filters.
